answers.reason: The senate decides on statutes and strategy of the whole university, and the junior professor is not mentioned as a member of it.
The budget planning round is a central body for allocating funds, not specific to the junior professor's faculty council or place of business.
The appointment committee selects candidates for vacant professorships, but the description does not place the junior professor on this committee.
The junior professor belongs to the faculty, but the text states members take part only in their designated place and the faculty council is chaired by the dean.
The study commission prepares degree programme changes, which is outside the specific duties of a junior professor.
Examination matters are handled by specific boards and officers, not by junior professors.
The internal research funding round awards small grants for research projects, fitting the research profile of a junior professor building up a research group.

Laboratory equipment procurement is for teaching laboratories, whereas the junior professor builds up a research group.
